items.title: 61125_Teddy Bunn oral history interview
items.q: So he stopped the band. ... So I popped him. ... the rest of the guys in the band was laughing. ... Edgar didn't have no business doing that.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Was that Edgar Hayes, or did you pick up some local musicians over there?
No. Was I with Edgar then? No, I wasn't with Edgar then.
